summary: HTML form and editing behavior is being refined across several user-facing areas: EditContext, the API for custom text editing, now handles composition, focus, and its anonymous editing element more reliably; select controls build their popup and row state from the DOM option list; and passkeys can appear in autocomplete="webauthn" suggestions. The changes also improve form validation, fieldset and label handling, combobox selection, shadow-DOM directionality, and privileged label cropping. These fixes make native controls and advanced editors more predictable without changing their basic purpose.
